services.name: Crab Island Boat Tour
services.desc: THE EASIEST WAY TO EXPERIENCE CRAB ISLAND, RELAX, CRUISE, SPOT DOLPHINS, SWIM, SNORKEL, AND ENJOY GOOD VIBES WITHOUT DRIVING A BOAT. Step aboard our spacious 49-passenger Corinthian boat for a fun, relaxing cruise to Crab Island near Destin, Florida. In about 10-15 minutes, you’ll enjoy a scenic ride along the Gulf Islands National Seashore on your way to one of the most iconic sandbars in the country.
